title: India PMI hits 56 — 9-month high. While Nifty crashed. Something doesn't add up. #Shorts
description:
India Manufacturing PMI reached 56.0 in November — the highest in 9 months. New orders surged. Output expanded. All this while Nifty fell 450 points the same week.

Watch to understand what's really happening inside India's economy.
